EngagementMeans.description: An approved weapon system is a weapon system or an aircraft type that has clearance to engage the target, with its weapon.

scl.description: This field identifies the standard conventional load (SCL) that is the load of the aircraft.

store.description: This field identifies the store that is the weapon. When the entry gives a standard conventional load (SCL), the SCL shall contain the store.

system.description: This field gives the weapon system or type of aircraft, such as `F-15E`, `M777` or `HIMARS`, as free text.

TSTEntry.description: A time-sensitive target entry is one row on the time-sensitive target (TST) list. The joint force commander designates each TST and has its engagement authority. The joint force commander may delegate this authority to a component commander or to a lower level. Forces prosecute a TST with dynamic targeting: find, fix, track, target, engage and assess.

activity_window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the target is possibly there or active.

authorized_engagement_means.description: This list contains the weapon systems that have clearance to prosecute the time-sensitive target (TST). Each entry gives the system, and can refer to the standard conventional load (SCL) and the weapon in the resource catalogue.

category.description: This field gives the type of the target, such as air defence or leadership, as free text. The types are local values and not a code list of the joint force.

engagement_authority.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that gives approval for the engagement of this target. The joint force commander has this authority and may delegate it to a component commander or to a lower level.

expected_locations.description: This list contains the positions at which the target can possibly be.

mgrs.description: This field gives the same position for display, in the Military Grid Reference System (MGRS), as free text. If the two values are different, the geographic position has priority.

name.description: This field gives the name of this possible location, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the possible location, as latitude and longitude.

expiration_criteria.description: This field gives the conditions or time for the removal of the target from the list, as free text.

expires_at.description: This field gives the time at which the target goes off the list, if no other condition removes it first.

priority.description: This field gives the priority of this target in relation to the other time-sensitive targets in the list. Priority 1 is the highest. The value is a local priority and not a priority level from the doctrine of the joint force.

roe_constraints.description: This field gives the rules of engagement (ROE) limits for this time-sensitive target (TST), as free text. These limits add to the usual ROE.

target.description: This field identifies the target that is this entry, in the resource catalogue.

target_description.description: This field gives the data about the type of the target and the signs that units can see, as free text.

tst_number.description: This field identifies this time-sensitive target (TST). Examples are `TST-01` and `TST-02`.

TSTEntry.title: TSTEntry

description: Time-sensitive targets (TST) are targets that it is necessary to engage immediately. A target is on the list when it is dangerous to friendly forces at this time or in a short time. A target of opportunity that is very important and available for a short time only is also on the list. Each entry has the data to find, identify and engage the target in its window.

$schema.description: This field identifies the schema that validates this document.

extensions.description: This field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group `sim` contains the simulator data of the record.

kind.description: The value identifies this record as a time-sensitive target (TST) list.

meta.description: This field gives the identification, revision and issue data of this list.

resources_ref.description: This field identifies the external resource catalogue that resolves the references of the list. The reference identifies the catalogue and gives its revision.

schema_version.description: This field gives the version of the openAIX schema that this time-sensitive target (TST) list agrees with.

targets.description: This list contains the time-sensitive targets of the mission. It is necessary to engage each target immediately.

title: Time-Sensitive Targets (TST)
